scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "api,worker,web" -c "blue,magenta,green" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:worker: uv run --directory backend python -m app.interfaces.worker run
scripts.api:export: uv run --directory backend python scripts/export_openapi.py && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('backend/openapi.json', 'frontend/openapi/openapi.json')"
